parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button located on the top of the toilet tank, typically made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water from the tank into the bowl for cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically or pivots slightly when pressed to trigger the flush valve.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A flat cover placed on top of the toilet tank, made of molded plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the tank to protect internal components and provide a clean appearance.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or removed for maintenance or cleaning.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main structural body of the toilet, made of glazed ceramic.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat, holds water, and channels waste to the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor.
